meta.name: caveman-review
meta.description: Ultra-compressed code review comments. Cuts noise from PR feedback while preserving the actionable signal. Each comment is one line: location, problem, fix. Use when user says "review this PR", "code review", "review the diff", "/review", or invokes /caveman-review. Auto-triggers when reviewing pull requests.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把冗长的代码审查压缩成一行精准反馈
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果受够了又长又水的代码审查意见
copy.tagline_en: Compress code review feedback into one-line actionable comments
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're tired of verbose and noisy code review comments

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 审查代码时会输出极简评论：每条一行，标注行号、问题点和修复建议。它自动省略客套话，用 emoji 标严重度；遇到安全漏洞等复杂问题则改用完整段落。只给评论，不直接改代码。
howto.when: 当你说“review this PR”“code review”“review the diff”等审查指令，或使用 /caveman-review 命令时触发；在审查 pull request 时也会自动启动。

say.text: 请用 caveman-review 审查这个 PR。
say.note: Claude 会输出压缩后的一行行评论。

say.text: 对当前 diff 做一次代码审查。
say.note: 触发精简评论，每条含位置、问题、修复。
直接进入极简审查模式。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude turns code review into one-line terse comments: location, problem, fix. It strips pleasantries, uses emoji severity markers, and switches to full paragraphs for security-level issues. Comments only—it doesn't modify code.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say 'review this PR', 'code review', 'review the diff', or invoke /caveman-review. It also auto-activates when reviewing pull requests.

say_en.text: Please review this PR with caveman-review.
say_en.note: Claude will output compressed line-by-line comments.

say_en.text: Do a code review on the current diff.
say_en.note: It gives one-line findings with location, problem, fix.
Directly triggers the terse review mode.
